task: Each item is an unfinished capability gap in a procedural game-building pipeline. Decide what kind of result finishing it would produce.
instructions: What would a player or level designer mainly get when this gap is closed?

criteria.visible-world: A visibly different game world: terrain shape, buildings, vegetation, water, lighting, colour or texture that can be seen in a screenshot
criteria.visible-behaviour: Visibly different behaviour in play: units navigating, fighting, moving, animating, camera motion
criteria.editor-tool: A new or better authoring action in the editor: placing, replacing, undo, saving, module/prefab handling
criteria.internal: Diagnostics, verification, refactoring, data plumbing or evidence only; nothing a player or designer would notice
criteria.unclear: The text does not say enough to tell
